title: Product fields (1 of 2)
summary: Part 1 of the product field ledger: 91 fields (catalogue_items.item_id … schema_fields.field_key). Index: CAP-FIELDS-PRODUCT.

fields.origin_detail: gen_random_uuid() at INSERT (migrations/000_baseline.sql)
fields.means: The product's identity; every other table points at it.
shown_in: Workshop › row id (data attribute, not printed)
fields.test: api: till-vendor.test.js, catalogue-read.test.js · web: till-catalogue.cjs, till-category-mostused.cjs

fields.origin_detail: the shop that owns it; every read runs under RLS withEntity
fields.means: Which shop owns this product.
fields.finding: Not shown anywhere on purpose (it is the tenant key).

fields.origin_detail: entity_schemas.schema_id (the shop's default product schema). Can dangle if the schema row is deleted: no FK found in the baseline
fields.means: Which column set (schema) this product was written under.
fields.finding: Every shop has ONE default schema and readers use the default, not this column; no reader of catalogue_items.schema_id found. Meaning is unclear (history of which schema?).

fields.origin_detail: a jsonb bag: every product fact below lives inside it; keys are declared in schema_fields but nothing binds them in the database
fields.means: All the facts about the product, as one document.
fields.set_by: Workshop product form, CSV import, adoption, Product Lab list adopt, connectors
fields.validated_by: schema_fields rules (required, number, min) via lib/catalogue-write.validateAgainst; declare-before-write in lib/catalogue-columns
fields.finding: Free-form: the 100-field problem lives here. This ledger is the declaration the database does not hold.

fields.origin_detail: false = product removed (soft delete, routes/products.js DELETE /:id)
fields.means: Whether the product is still in the catalogue (false = removed).
fields.finding: Soft delete keeps media bytes in the object store (see garbage G1).

fields.origin_detail: now() at INSERT
fields.means: When the product was first added.
fields.finding: No screen found that prints it; only ordering. Candidate to mark "kept for audit".

fields.origin_detail: set to NOW() by the UPDATE statements in routes/products.js (not a trigger)
fields.means: When the product last changed.
fields.finding: Written by hand in each UPDATE, so a writer that forgets it leaves it stale (two writers in routes/products.js set it; others unchecked).

fields.origin_detail: typed on the product form / sheet; schema-bootstrap declares it required
fields.means: What the product is called.
fields.set_by: Workshop product form (owner, staff), CSV import, adoption, till setup

fields.origin_detail: typed/picked; canonicalised by lib/units.js (kg = KGM)
fields.means: What one sold unit is (kg, piece, plate…).
fields.set_by: Workshop product form, import (default from the trade blueprint)
fields.validated_by: units.js alias table; LOCKED column; blank becomes "unit" in ctReadForm and "piece" at the till
fields.finding: Three defaults for a blank unit: "unit" (form), "piece" (till), blueprint defaultUnit (import).

fields.origin_detail: typed; stored as { amount, currency } after money.stampItem (currency from the shop's region)
fields.means: The selling price of one unit before offers (tax treatment per the slab).
fields.set_by: Workshop product form, import, scheduled change, till setup, adoption (adopter's commercials overlay)
fields.validated_by: schema_fields number + min_value 0; a bare number or a money object both accepted; amountOf/priceOf readers
fields.finding: Stored in two shapes (bare number and {amount,currency}); every reader must use money.priceOf.

fields.origin_detail: typed, or minted from the blueprint code series (prefix + sequence)
fields.means: The shop's own short code or barcode text for the product.
fields.set_by: Workshop product form, import, blueprint mint
fields.validated_by: unique within the shop at import (preflight duplicates); no check on the form (?)
fields.finding: Same fact as sku: the till reads code||sku, the CSV synonym table maps "code" onto sku, the form writes code. Two names, one meaning.

fields.origin_detail: CSV header synonyms (code, item code, barcode, ean, id…) all fold onto sku
fields.means: The identifier column of an uploaded sheet (same meaning as code).
fields.set_by: CSV/Excel import, connectors; not on the product form
shown_in: Till › item row (as code when code is empty)
fields.finding: Duplicate of code (see item_data.code). Propose: one key, the other kept as read-only alias until data is moved.

fields.origin_detail: free text; short form is what the live catalogue writes
fields.means: A sentence about the product, for the customer.
fields.validated_by: text only; exposure switch "description" hides it from the public copy
fields.finding: desc vs description: exposure.js strips both, cart.js reads both, the form writes desc only.

fields.origin_detail: long synonym of desc from imports
fields.means: Same as desc (long spelling).
fields.set_by: CSV import only (SYNONYMS maps description → desc, so normally folded)
fields.finding: Alias of desc kept only by readers; fold() should leave nothing here. Verify with the survey (rows where both exist).

fields.origin_detail: one line typed on the product form; empty clears it
fields.means: One short line the shop wants noticed on this product.
fields.finding: Meant to be noticed, but settable and shown in the workshop only; not on the till, bill, online shop or export. A customer never sees it.

fields.origin_detail: a starter column (retail) or typed column
fields.means: The maker's brand name.
fields.set_by: Catalogue setup › Columns (declared), then the product form "More about this product"

fields.origin_detail: declared column or typed; till falls back to grade
fields.means: Which variant of the product this row is (size, flavour).
fields.finding: variant vs grade: the till shows variant||grade; catalogue_item_version copies variant.

fields.origin_detail: starter column (veg)
fields.means: Quality grade (A, B, extra-fancy).
shown_in: Workshop catalogue › product detail › More about this product
fields.finding: Doubles as a variant label at the till.

fields.origin_detail: typed on the Identifiers tab, imported, or minted as a 5-digit scale PLU by the blueprint (position in the starter list)
fields.means: The number a scanner or a weighing scale reads.
fields.finding: Till reads barcode||ean; csv synonyms fold barcode/ean onto sku. Three homes for "the number on the pack": code, sku, barcode.

fields.origin_detail: alias read by the till projection
fields.means: Same as barcode (EAN spelling).
fields.set_by: Import only (no screen offers an ean input)
fields.finding: Read as a fallback in routes/till.js only; csv SYNONYMS fold ean to sku, so a stored ean means the fold was bypassed.

fields.origin_detail: per-language starter names {ta:[…],hi:[…]} copied from the blueprint pack at mint; flattened into synonyms per shop
fields.means: The product's local-language names, by language.
fields.source: blueprint pack (lib/catalogue-blueprint LOCAL_NAMES) → minted into synonyms
fields.finding: Intermediate: travels with starter rows (storeRows) but is not a stored product key after mint; confirm in the survey that no row keeps item_data.names.

fields.origin_detail: one per line on the product form; also seeded from blueprint local names
fields.means: The shop's own other words for the product (thakkali = tomato).
fields.set_by: Workshop product form (Synonyms tab), blueprint mint, import
fields.validated_by: array of text; RESERVED from column-declaration
fields.finding: Hidden from export (HIDDEN) and public copy by default; a shop cannot round-trip them through a sheet.

fields.origin_detail: [{by,text,unit,factor}]: what a supplier calls it; capped at 20 in the till projection
fields.means: What each supplier calls this product, with a carton-to-piece factor.
fields.finding: Written by goods-in; no catalogue input edits it (not found).

fields.origin_detail: the public URL of the FIRST image in media (routes/products.js sets it on upload, clears it on delete); or a pics/ path from the blueprint
fields.means: The picture shown on the tile, row and card.
fields.set_by: system on media upload; blueprint mint; import
fields.finding: A copy of media[0] with the API host baked into the URL (PUBLIC_API_URL); if the host changes every stored URL is stale. exposure.media deletes media/images/image_url but not image.

fields.origin_detail: [{id,key,name,mime,kind,size,at}] pictures in the object store; videos as links {provider,vid,embed,url}
fields.means: The pictures and video links of the product.
fields.set_by: Workshop › Media tab (upload, video link, remove)
fields.validated_by: MEDIA_MAX 8 MB; videoLink() accepts YouTube/Vimeo only
fields.finding: Bytes are not deleted when the PRODUCT is removed (soft delete) — garbage G1.

fields.origin_detail: [{role,system,id,direction,source,at}] buyer/seller ids for this product
fields.means: The ids other parties use for this product (a buyer's item code).
fields.set_by: Workshop › Identifiers tab (Add id; saved at once)
used_by: ? — no server reader found by grep; e2e identifiers.spec says "it matches, it travels"
fields.finding: The screen promises "an order quoting any of these ids lands on this product". Grep finds NO reader in the API or other pages (only app.html + e2e). Either the match lives in a path not found, or the promise has no engine behind it. Verify before more screens lean on it.

fields.origin_detail: typed (a declared column) or imported; HSN is its own canonical in csv-preflight
fields.means: The tax classification code of the goods (HSN) or service (SAC).
fields.set_by: Catalogue columns, product form "More about this product", import, Pricing & tax pane
fields.validated_by: format check: ? (none found on write); tax engine looks up slab by it
fields.finding: Also stored as hsn_code and hs_code; the till reads hsn||hs_code||hsn_code. Service uses sac_code (starter) too.

fields.origin_detail: alias spelling
fields.means: Same as hsn.
fields.finding: Alias read by tax and the till; no screen writes it.

fields.origin_detail: starter column for gold/coffee/trade (international HS)
fields.means: The international customs code (HS).
shown_in: Workshop catalogue › product detail › More about this product
fields.finding: Third spelling of the classification code.

fields.origin_detail: service starter column
fields.means: The service accounting code (SAC) for tax.
shown_in: Workshop catalogue › product detail › More about this product
fields.finding: No reader: tax reads hsn (services.js uses hsn). SAC and HSN are one slot in the tax engine; this key is never read.

fields.origin_detail: the travelling copy of the cited slab's rate, written together with tax_slab by CBTaxSlab.setOn; or typed from a sheet
fields.means: The tax percentage the product carries, copied for counterparties who cannot read our slab id.
fields.source: definition (tax slab) — this is a copy
fields.set_by: Pricing & tax pane (via setOn); import; typed column
fields.validated_by: number; stale if the slab's rate changes (refresh: ? — slab edit re-points via slab-cites.takeover, not this copy)
shown_in: Workshop catalogue › product detail › Pricing & tax
fields.test: api: tax-slab.test.js, tax-lines.test.js · web: tax-takeover.spec.js, tax-slab.test.cjs
fields.finding: Two sources with tax_slab: the slab and this copy. Not in the till projection (routes/till.js tillItem) — the counter derives the rate from tax_slab/category.

fields.origin_detail: definition_id of a tax slab; may dangle if the slab is deleted (slab-cites.cites counts users first); blank = inherit category then catalogue default
fields.means: Which tax slab the product is taxed by.
fields.validated_by: RESERVED from typed columns (cited by id only); slab must exist (UI picker)
shown_in: Workshop catalogue › product detail › Pricing & tax
fields.test: api: tax-slab.test.js, slab-cites.test.js · web: tax-slab.test.cjs, tax-takeover.spec.js

fields.origin_detail: copy of the slab's name written with tax_slab
fields.means: The cited slab's name, for counterparties.
shown_in: Workshop catalogue › product detail › Pricing & tax
fields.finding: Copy; refresh when slab is renamed: ? (not found).

fields.origin_detail: printed maximum retail price; its own canonical (never folded onto price)
fields.means: The price printed on the pack — the ceiling a consumer may be charged.
fields.set_by: Catalogue columns / product form "More about this product", import (blueprint carries it)
fields.validated_by: number; relation to price: not checked (price > mrp allowed?) — ?
fields.test: api: network-catalogue.test.cjs, till-vendor.test.js · web: network-catalogue.spec.js, till-verify.spec.js
fields.finding: Batch MRP (lot fields) may differ from the product MRP: two sources by design, not resolved in the ledger.

fields.origin_detail: { value, source: manual|rule|tally|zoho, updated_at, note }
fields.means: What one unit costs the shop (never shown to customers).
fields.set_by: Offer Lab, product form (declared column), connectors (Tally/Zoho)
fields.validated_by: lib/item-cost.js shape; fold() never maps cost onto price
used_by: exposure strip (deleted from every public copy)
fields.test: api: item-cost.test.js, exposure-cost.test.js · web: offer-lab-next-offline.cjs, offer-lab-next-pricelist.cjs

fields.origin_detail: lower bound of a negotiable price band, stamped {amount,currency}
fields.means: The lowest price the seller will take (a band, not a price).
fields.set_by: Import / declared column; no dedicated input
fields.finding: Read by shop and cart; no product-form input offers it.

fields.origin_detail: upper bound of the band
fields.means: The highest price in the seller's band.
fields.set_by: Import / declared column; no dedicated input

fields.origin_detail: definition_id of a pricing structure (fixed / tiered / range); can dangle if the definition is deleted
fields.means: Which pricing structure (price breaks, band) the product cites.
shown_in: Workshop catalogue › product detail › Pricing & tax
used_by: pricing engine unitPrice (product page, cart, till, server)

fields.origin_detail: travelling copy of the cited structure's kind
fields.means: Fixed, tiered or range — copied from the cited structure.
used_by: pricing engine at the till without the line
fields.finding: Copy so the till can price offline; refresh on structure edit: ? (not found).

fields.origin_detail: travelling copy of the cited pricing structure (pricing_tiers)
fields.means: Copied from the cited pricing structure so the line is explainable offline and months later.
fields.finding: Copy of the structure; two sources until refreshed.

fields.origin_detail: travelling copy of the cited pricing structure (pricing_amount)
fields.means: Copied from the cited pricing structure so the line is explainable offline and months later.
fields.finding: Copy of the structure; two sources until refreshed.

fields.origin_detail: travelling copy of the cited pricing structure (pricing_min)
fields.means: Copied from the cited pricing structure so the line is explainable offline and months later.
fields.finding: Copy of the structure; two sources until refreshed.

fields.origin_detail: travelling copy of the cited pricing structure (pricing_max)
fields.means: Copied from the cited pricing structure so the line is explainable offline and months later.
fields.finding: Copy of the structure; two sources until refreshed.

fields.origin_detail: travelling copy of the cited pricing structure (pricing_def_name)
fields.means: Copied from the cited pricing structure so the line is explainable offline and months later.
shown_in: Workshop catalogue › product detail › Pricing & tax
fields.finding: Copy of the structure; two sources until refreshed.

fields.origin_detail: csv canonical lead time; also a declared commercial of a network source (catalogue-build COMMERCIALS_FIELDS)
fields.means: How many days from order to dispatch.
fields.set_by: Import / sheet column (TRADE_EXTRAS in the template) / declared column; no product-form input
fields.validated_by: number via schema type; none otherwise
used_by: catalogue-read CORE (travels on every adopted line)
fields.finding: Offered as a sheet column and carried on every line (lib/catalogue-read CORE), but no screen shows it and no engine decides on it. Decide: surface it on the order page or mark "carried, not acted on".

fields.origin_detail: csv canonical MOQ
fields.means: The smallest quantity the seller will accept for this product.
fields.set_by: Import / sheet column / declared column; no product-form input
used_by: catalogue-read CORE (travels on every adopted line)
fields.finding: Same as lead_time_days. The working equivalent is item_data.order min/max/step (the order model), so MOQ is a second source for the same limit.

fields.origin_detail: array of category definition ids; a deleted category can leave a dangling id (categories.js blocks delete while cited? ?)
fields.means: Which categories (shelves) the product sits in.
fields.set_by: Workshop product form category picker; Categories screen; import by name
fields.validated_by: RESERVED from typed columns; ids resolved by categories.js
shown_in: Till › item row chips and By-category

fields.origin_detail: positional copy of the category names, written with categories
fields.means: The category names, for counterparties who cannot resolve our ids.
fields.finding: Copy; rename on Categories screen refreshes it (per comments); unverified in the survey.

fields.origin_detail: legacy single-category key — "read, never written again"
fields.means: The old single category name.
fields.set_by: nobody (import of a legacy sheet still writes it?)
shown_in: Till › item row (fallback when categories is empty)
fields.finding: Legacy; test categories.test.js says nothing writes it. Survey: rows still holding it.

fields.origin_detail: available · unavailable · retired · redundant (itemstatus.js)
fields.means: Whether the product may be sold or matched right now.
fields.set_by: Workshop ◍ Status control; till Stock-out (POST /api/till/stock); bulk status route

fields.origin_detail: { qty, source, as_of }
fields.means: How many are on hand, and the date that was true.
fields.set_by: Workshop ("report it"), connectors, POST availability (bulk), sheet qty
fields.validated_by: availability.stamp (a count needs a date); absent ≠ 0
fields.finding: Third quantity home next to stock_balance (ledger) and item_data.qty.

fields.origin_detail: blueprint rows carry qty (CARRIED list); the sheet import turns qty into avail.qty
fields.means: Quantity as typed in a starter list or a sheet.
fields.finding: If blueprint mint stores qty raw, it is a second quantity beside avail that nothing reads. Survey: rows with item_data.qty.

fields.origin_detail: export-only projection of status (yes/no); on import it sets status and a fresh as_of
fields.means: Yes/no column of a spreadsheet for "can be bought".
fields.finding: Not a stored key; listed because it is a column a person sees.

fields.origin_detail: true/false; adoption can seed it from a lot pack
fields.means: Whether goods-in must record a batch/serial for this product.
fields.test: api: stock-cycle.test.js, adopt.test.js · web: adopt.spec.js, adopt-screen.spec.js
fields.finding: Same question as pharma starter column tracking (none/lot/serial). Two names, two shapes.

fields.origin_detail: pharma starter column: none | lot | serial
fields.means: Whether the product is tracked by lot or serial.
shown_in: Workshop catalogue › product detail › More about this product
fields.finding: Nothing reads it; lotfields reads batch_tracked. Looks like control but controls nothing.

fields.origin_detail: [{name, required, options:[{name, price}]}] normalised by variant.normalize
fields.means: The choices a dish has (size, spice) and what each adds to the price.
fields.validated_by: variant.normalize strips unknown fields; groupsOf drops unsellable groups
fields.test: api: variant.test.js, combo-templates.test.cjs · web: prod-modifiers-tab.cjs, combo-lab.cjs

fields.origin_detail: parts a meal deal replaces
fields.means: The parts a combo stands for.
fields.set_by: Combo templates / combo lab (product link b267); input on product form: ?
fields.finding: Read by the till; the writer is combo-templates (product_item_id) — not a product-form input.

fields.origin_detail: minimum age in years (COTPA, excise)
fields.means: The age a buyer must be to buy this.
fields.finding: Law-relevant and settable only as a hand-typed declared column.

fields.origin_detail: array of offer ids, or ["*"]
fields.means: Offers this product is kept out of.
fields.set_by: Workshop › Offers switch; exposure.offers sets ["*"] on the public copy

fields.origin_detail: { tax, offers, stock, synonyms, hsn, description, media } booleans overriding the shop's defaults
fields.means: What a customer may see of this item.
shown_in: Workshop catalogue › product detail › Shown to customers

fields.origin_detail: boolean: shown on the shop screen
fields.means: Whether the product was picked by hand for the shop screen.
fields.finding: No catalogue input; set from the counter screen only.

fields.origin_detail: {ref} citing a catalogue order model, or {kind,min,max,step} own model
fields.means: How the quantity is ordered (count, measure, pack, range).
fields.validated_by: catalogue-model quantity models; ref must exist: ?
shown_in: Workshop catalogue › product detail › Order model preview

fields.origin_detail: form-only datetime: changes are queued as a schedule, not stored on the product
fields.means: When an edit should take effect.
fields.finding: Not a stored key; applied rows stay in catalogue_item_schedule (garbage G3).

fields.origin_detail: an adopter's overlay (price, availability) on a line referenced from a brand catalogue
fields.means: What this shop changes on a product it adopts by reference.

fields.origin_detail: where a referenced line came from
fields.means: The system's bookkeeping of the origin of an adopted line.
fields.finding: Bookkeeping key, hidden from export on purpose; no view.

fields.origin_detail: a network a product belongs to
fields.finding: Read by reporting.js; no screen or route writes it.

fields.origin_detail: free text on a product row
fields.finding: As network_id.

fields.origin_detail: categories[0] of item_data
fields.means: First cited category id, so the counter can cite it back.

fields.origin_detail: synonyms joined by space
fields.means: The shop's own words flattened for the counter's search.

fields.origin_detail: aliases[0..20].text joined
fields.means: Supplier names flattened for search.

fields.origin_detail: the FIRST THREE columns by display_order of the default schema, value trimmed to 40 chars
fields.means: The shop's declared facts shown under a till row.
fields.finding: By reading (not run): the starter order is name, unit, price, code, desc…, so the first three declared columns are name/unit/price and a pharmacy's composition or a paint shade (4th onward) never reaches the counter. The comment promises the opposite.

fields.origin_detail: tax rate cached on the in-memory item by rateOf() the first time it is asked
fields.means: The tax rate computed for this row, cached on the till item.
fields.finding: Intermediate on the counter's in-memory item; cleared when the snapshot reloads. Survey n/a (never stored).

fields.origin_detail: written by the b146 trigger
fields.means: Id of the version row.

fields.origin_detail: written by the b146 trigger
fields.means: Which product this version belongs to (catalogue_items.item_id); no FK found, so rows survive a hard delete.

fields.origin_detail: written by the b146 trigger
fields.means: Owning shop (RLS).

fields.origin_detail: written by the b146 trigger
fields.means: Sequence number of the version.

fields.origin_detail: cb_catalogue_version_cut() trigger on INSERT/UPDATE OF item_data (b146)
fields.means: The whole item_data as it was.

fields.origin_detail: cb_catalogue_version_cut() trigger on INSERT/UPDATE OF item_data (b146)
fields.means: Name at that time (cb_item_fields(item_data)).
fields.finding: Denormalised copy of snapshot; same facts twice inside one row.

fields.origin_detail: cb_catalogue_version_cut() trigger on INSERT/UPDATE OF item_data (b146)
fields.means: Variant at that time.
fields.finding: Denormalised copy of snapshot; same facts twice inside one row.

fields.origin_detail: cb_catalogue_version_cut() trigger on INSERT/UPDATE OF item_data (b146)
fields.means: Unit at that time.
fields.finding: Denormalised copy of snapshot; same facts twice inside one row.

fields.origin_detail: cb_catalogue_version_cut() trigger on INSERT/UPDATE OF item_data (b146)
fields.means: Price at that time.
fields.finding: Denormalised copy of snapshot; same facts twice inside one row.

fields.origin_detail: cb_catalogue_version_cut() trigger on INSERT/UPDATE OF item_data (b146)
fields.means: Code/sku at that time.
fields.finding: Denormalised copy of snapshot; same facts twice inside one row.

fields.origin_detail: cb_catalogue_version_cut() trigger on INSERT/UPDATE OF item_data (b146)
fields.means: Status at that time.
fields.finding: Denormalised copy of snapshot; same facts twice inside one row.

fields.origin_detail: written by the b146 trigger
fields.means: When this version began.

fields.origin_detail: written by the b146 trigger
fields.means: When it was superseded (null = current).

fields.origin_detail: written by the b146 trigger
fields.means: Who made the change (?).

fields.origin_detail: written by the b146 trigger
fields.means: When the row was written.

fields.origin_detail: a row of schema_fields; written by routes/schemas.js and lib/catalogue-columns.ensureDeclared
fields.means: Id of the column definition.
fields.set_by: Catalogue setup › Columns (owner), ensureDeclared on writes

fields.origin_detail: a row of schema_fields; written by routes/schemas.js and lib/catalogue-columns.ensureDeclared
fields.means: Which schema (column set) it belongs to.
fields.set_by: Catalogue setup › Columns (owner), ensureDeclared on writes

fields.origin_detail: a row of schema_fields; written by routes/schemas.js and lib/catalogue-columns.ensureDeclared
fields.means: The label people read.
fields.set_by: Catalogue setup › Columns (owner), ensureDeclared on writes

fields.origin_detail: a row of schema_fields; written by routes/schemas.js and lib/catalogue-columns.ensureDeclared
fields.means: The key written into item_data.
fields.set_by: Catalogue setup › Columns (owner), ensureDeclared on writes
fields.validated_by: column-rules (LOCKED name/unit/price; retypeWhy/why tighten on use)
